author: Widogeist
body: When the tower first came out, it was accessible for up to a week after the event ended. I'm guessing because this is a "re-run" of the event, it will likely end when the event ends. Although I haven't seen any confirmation in Discord.

author: KevineCove
body: The towers themselves have a note on them that says when they become unavailable. In the past it's often been a week after the event officially ends.
